facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT says the roll-out of the Digital Authentication and E-signatures platform (UGPass) is ongoing and continues to enable end-to-end delivery of e-government services (Permanent Secretary Aminah Zawedde, via Business Focus).

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance

UGA.note: No civil service digital-skills training is stated.
The National Data Centre is described as hosting government applications only; no rental to outside organisations or Tier is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT says 6,270 farmers were skilled in 50 districts, 5,225 participants trained under the Community ICT programme across many districts, and 2,339 women and 927 elderly people trained with partners (Zawedde, via Business Focus).

UGA.note: No measured share of people with digital skills.

facts.fact: The ministry says four Regional Resource Centres in Arua, Gulu, Mbarara and Mbale were equipped with assistive technologies and equipment, in partnership with the National Council for PWDs (Zawedde, via Business Focus).

UGA.note: No e-commerce or electronic transactions law is mentioned.
The ministry says automation of government processes is still slow and names no count of services online or a portal.

facts.fact: The ministry says government has laid 4,387 km of optic fibre across 57 of 135 districts (42%), with 1,567 government sites (MDAs and local governments) connected to the National Backbone Infrastructure (Zawedde, via Business Focus).

UGA.note: Not every region is stated reached; no open-access terms.
The ministry's 67% is a 'penetration' figure, not a stated share of people using the internet.

facts.fact: The ministry says 1,567 government sites, MDAs and local governments together, were connected to the National Backbone Infrastructure; the split for local governments is not given (Zawedde, via Business Focus).

UGA.note: No count of local governments connected; plan to connect them in 2025.

facts.fact: The ministry says the National Data Centre and a Disaster Recovery Site are in use for centralised hosting of government applications and data, and the data centre hosts 306 applications for over 100 entities (Zawedde, via Business Focus).

UGA.note: Not stated as for hire, and no Tier.
A Disaster Recovery Site is named with no place, so its distance from the main site is unknown.
No school internet figure or compulsory curriculum is stated.
Innovation grants to 132 innovators are stated under a support programme, but no startup law, strategy or labelling.

facts.fact: The ministry says a National ICT Innovation Hub with capacity for over 500 innovators has been constructed in Nakawa, and UNDP supported ICT Business Incubation Hubs at public universities, with no programme cohort stated (Zawedde, via Business Focus).
